读不了这种文件：{name}。可以发图片、PDF、Word、Excel、Powe: Can't read this kind of file: {name}. You can send images, PDFs, Word, Excel or PowerPoint files, or text files.
读取助手自己保存的数据（以前的会话、设置、待办都在这个目录里）：\n\n:
read the assistant's own saved data (past conversations, settings and to-dos live in this folder):

    {path}
读取工作目录之外的内容：\n\n {path}:
read something outside the working folder:

    {path}
账本里有 {n} 行读不懂（可能是写到一半时断电了），已经跳过。: {n} line(s) in the record couldn't be read (perhaps cut off by a power loss) and were skipped.
还有没保存的修改，再按一次就放弃。: You have unsaved changes. Do it again to discard them.
还没有保存的会话。发出第一条消息后，它会出现在这里，下次打开还能接着聊。: No saved conversations yet. Once you send your first message, it shows up here and you can pick it up again next time.
还没有保存过会话，文件夹还不存在。: No conversations have been saved yet, so the folder doesn't exist.
还没有花费记录。从现在起，每调用一次模型都会记一笔：花了多少、用的哪个模型、是对: No spending recorded yet. From now on, every model call is recorded: what it cost, which model, and whether it came from a chat or a scheduled task.
还没有记忆。对助手说“记住……”，它会把要点写成文件放在这里，以后的每段对话都用: Nothing remembered yet. Tell the assistant “Remember…” and it will write the key points to a file here, for every future conversation to use.
还没有设置 {label} 的 API 密钥，助手需要它才能调用模型。有两种办法:
No {label} API key is set yet, and the assistant needs one to call the model. There are two ways to add it:

  1. Run uv run harness --web and enter it under Settings in the top-right corner (easiest).
  2. Open {env_file} and add a line:
         {key_env}=your-key

Get an API key at {key_page}. APIs are billed by usage, separately from chat app subscriptions.
还没有设置 {provider} 的 API 密钥，填好之后就可以开始对话。: No {provider} API key yet. Add one to start chatting.
还没有设置 {provider} 的 API 密钥，请先点右上角的“设置”填写。: No {provider} API key is set yet. Click Settings in the top-right corner to add one.
还没有设置 {provider} 的 API 密钥：打开页面后，点右上角的“设置: No {provider} API key yet: once the page opens, click Settings in the top-right corner to add one.
还读不了音频和视频：{name}。可以把文字稿或者截图发过来。: Audio and video can't be read yet: {name}. You can send a transcript or a screenshot instead.
这一轮已经调用了 {n} 次模型，先停在这里。输入“继续”可以接着做。: This turn has already called the model {n} times, so it stops here. Type “continue” to keep going.
这一项是指向别处的链接，为了安全，不在这里打开或删除。: This item is a link pointing somewhere else. For safety, it can't be opened or deleted here.
这不像是一个 API 密钥：里面不能有空格、换行或中文: That doesn't look like an API key: it can't contain spaces, line breaks or Chinese characters
这不是一个文件。文件夹请在文件管理器里处理。: This isn't a file. Manage folders in your file manager.
这不是文本文件，没法在这里显示。可以打开记忆文件夹查看。: This isn't a text file, so it can't be shown here. You can open the memory folder to look at it.
这个 API 密钥没有权限执行该请求：{error}: This API key isn't allowed to make this request: {error}
这个文件不是 UTF-8 编码的文字，在这里改会把它弄坏。请在记忆文件夹里用别的: This file isn't UTF-8 text, and editing it here would damage it. Edit it in the memory folder with another app.
这个文件夹里已经有一个叫 {name} 的文件了。: There's already a file called {name} in this folder.
这个月已经花了 {spent}，超过了每月预算 {budget}。只是提醒，不会: You've spent {spent} this month, more than your {budget} monthly budget. This is only a reminder; nothing is blocked.
这个月的花费超过它时提醒你一次，不会拦住任何操作。调高以后又超过了，会再提醒一次: When this month's spending passes it, you get one reminder. Nothing is ever blocked. If you raise it and spending passes the new amount, you're reminded again.
这个目录里有哪些文件？: What files are in this folder?
这个确认请求已经处理过了: This permission request has already been answered
这些调用发生时，模型还没有价格，只记下了 token 数，没有算进上面的金额。在: These calls had no price when they happened, so only their tokens were recorded and they aren't in the totals above. Add a price in Settings and later calls will be counted.
这份备份不含 API 密钥：它们保存在 .env 文件里，不在数据文件夹里。: This backup contains no API keys: they live in the .env file, which isn't in the data folder.
这是 {model} 现在用来估算的价格，可以改成你实际的价格。: These are the prices currently used to estimate {model}; change them to what you actually pay.
这条消息的搜索次数已经用完，助手会根据已有的信息回答: No web searches left for this message; the assistant will answer with what it has
这条消息读取网页的次数已经用完: No page fetches left for this message
这条记忆不存在，可能已经被删除了。: This memory doesn't exist. It may have been deleted.
这条记忆刚刚在别处被改过了（可能是助手改的）。你的修改还在；保存时会先问你要不要: This memory was just changed elsewhere (perhaps by the assistant). Your edits are still here; saving will ask before overwriting it.
这条记忆刚刚更新过，下面是最新的内容。: This memory was just updated. Below is the latest version.
这条记忆在你编辑的时候被改过了（可能是助手改的）。你的修改还在框里：再点一次“保: This memory changed while you were editing it (perhaps the assistant changed it). Your edits are still in the box: click “Save” again to overwrite it with your version.
这条记忆太长了，这里只读出了开头，没法在这里改。请在记忆文件夹里用别的软件编辑。: This memory is too long: only its beginning was read, so it can't be edited here. Edit it in the memory folder with another app.
这条记忆已经不在了。: This memory is no longer there.
这条记忆已经不在了：可能被助手删掉或改了名字，也可能是在文件夹里被删掉了。: This memory is no longer there. The assistant may have deleted or renamed it, or it was deleted from the folder.
这段会话不存在，可能已经被删除了。: This conversation doesn't exist; it may have been deleted.
这段会话用的模型提供方，这个版本的程序已经不支持了。: This version of the program no longer supports the provider this conversation used.
这段会话的历史约有 {tokens} 个 token。接着聊的第一条消息需要把它: This conversation's history is about {tokens} tokens. If you continue, your first message sends all of it to the model again, and it's billed accordingly.
这段会话的文件读不出来，可能已经损坏。: This conversation's file can't be read; it may be damaged.
这段会话还没有保存：第一轮对话结束后才会写到磁盘上。: This conversation isn't saved yet: it's written to disk once the first turn finishes.
这段时间里没有调用过模型。: No model calls in this period.
连接不上 Anthropic 的服务器，请检查网络。: Can't reach Anthropic's servers. Check your network.
连接不上 {provider} 的服务器，请检查网络。: Can't reach {provider}'s servers. Check your network.
连接不上助手程序。它可能已经退出，请回到终端重新运行。: Can't reach the assistant program. It may have quit: go back to the terminal and run it again.
连接已断开：助手程序可能已经退出或重新启动了。请回到终端，用那里显示的新地址打开: Disconnected: the assistant program may have quit or restarted. Go back to the terminal and open the new address shown there.
里面可能有密钥，但它不是合法的 JSON，没法只遮住密钥，所以整个没有导出: it may hold secrets but isn't valid JSON, so they couldn't be masked on their own; the whole file was left out
链接无效或已经过期。请使用终端里显示的完整地址重新打开。: This link is invalid or has expired. Open the full address shown in the terminal again.
附件“{name}”的内容编码不正确（应该是 base64）。: The attachment “{name}” isn't encoded correctly (it should be base64).
附件加起来太大了：一条消息连同附件最多约 64 MB。可以分成几条发。: The attachments are too large together: a message with its attachments can be up to about 64 MB. Try splitting them across several messages.
附件的格式不正确。: The attachment isn't in the right format.
附件还在读取，请稍等一下再发送。: Attachments are still being read. Wait a moment, then send.
预算要填一个大于 0 的数（美元）: The budget must be a number greater than 0 (US dollars)
